rooms.name: Fern Corridor
rooms.description: A long green passage connects the conservatory rooms. Rain ticks against the glass roof and water gathers along the iron frames.

rooms.name: Orchid Gallery
rooms.description: Moonlit orchids fill a tiled gallery. One brass-framed display case stands open beneath a cracked thermometer.

rooms.name: Curator's Office
rooms.description: Plant catalogues and correspondence cover the curator's desk. A key ledger is kept in a locked drawer.

rooms.name: Potting Shed
rooms.description: Terracotta pots and bags of rich soil crowd the benches. A silver watering can sits upside down beside the seed trays.

rooms.name: Boiler Room
rooms.description: The old greenhouse boiler keeps the glasshouse warm. Its pressure gauge and coal tally are logged every hour.
